name: wago-website
description: Landing page for wago - a pure-Go WebAssembly Runtime (wago.sh)

scripts.build: npm run sync:ai:check && tsc && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html assets data CNAME install.sh robots.txt sitemap.xml site.webmanifest schema.json llms.txt llms-full.txt dist/
scripts.sync: node scripts/sync-stats.mjs && node scripts/sync-schema.mjs && node scripts/sync-ai-metadata.mjs
scripts.sync:check: node scripts/sync-stats.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-schema.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-ai-metadata.mjs --check
